India beat England in shootout to round off 2025-26 season of FIH Hockey Pro League
The Indian Men’s Hockey Team displayed remarkable defensive resilience to defeat England 3-2 in the penalty shoot-out after a hard-fought 0-0 draw in the reverse fixture of the FIH Hockey Pro League in London on Sunday. Abhishek, Shilanand Lakra and Hardik Singh converted their shoot-out attempts for India, while goalkeeper Mohith HS also starred by foiling three England attempts.
